sealed_before_running: 2026-10-28 (coordinator order after the architecture contract of the heuristic-strategy README, section 'Strategy architecture and design method'); none of the panels below has been run when this file is committed

D3_unseen_confirmation.never_used_before: seeds 0-2 are the development / qualification seeds; 3-5 were never generated in any matrix, DEAP subset or diagnostic
D3_unseen_confirmation.cells: every base cell of the matrix queue, perfect heads, with its zero-cost twin and exact mirror at the first seed

arms.deap_no_reversal: the DEAP point with allow_reverse = 0 (D6 variant)

D3_unseen_confirmation.paired_statistic: per base cell: mean over seeds of the daily Sharpe and of the net USD; paired difference deap - canonical; 95 % bootstrap CI over base cells (10000 resamples, seed 20261028)
D3_unseen_confirmation.claim_rule: an improvement is claimed only if the CI lower bound is > 0; otherwise the report states 'no demonstrated gain'
D3_unseen_confirmation.qualification_rule: the matrix verdict on seeds 3-5 (governing forms, VALIDITY_SPEC) is reported next to seeds 0-2; a cell that passes on 0-2 and fails on 3-5 is listed as a generalisation failure

D4_seeded_positions.construction: an order opened age bars before the seeding tick with the strategy's envelope on a clean engine; the episode starts at the seeding tick in the stated P&L state; the closer alone decides (opener frozen)

expected.sl_destined_closed_before_sl: >= 0.95 per (age, state, side) with >= 30 SL-destined episodes
expected.normalized_regret: mean <= 0.10 and p90 <= 0.30 per (age, state, side)
expected.no_post_termination_extrema: V*(t) searches only up to the first automatic termination (SL / TP / compulsory exit); asserted by construction and by a fixture

D4_reversal_then_recovery.selection: episodes whose path first moves >= 0.5 sigma against the position and then reaches TP or a net >= +0.5 sigma before any SL

expected.profitable_hold: the closer's premature-exit regret mean <= 0.10 normalized and its early-close share <= O*'s + 0.05 on these episodes

permuted_outputs.how: every head output row-permuted inside the block (one fixed permutation, seed 20261028)
permuted_outputs.expected: net USD within [-1.5, -0.5] x total trading costs (permuted signals lose about the costs); daily Sharpe <= 0

swapped_direction_channels.how: long and short head outputs swapped
swapped_direction_channels.expected: net USD < 0 on every trend cell (mirrored losses); in each trend cell the swapped net is <= -0.5 x the unswapped net

delayed_outputs.how: every head output delayed by 1, 3 and 6 bars (the value of t - k used at t)
delayed_outputs.expected: daily Sharpe non-increasing in the delay (0 >= 1 >= 3 >= 6, tolerance 0.05) and Sharpe(6) < Sharpe(0)

D5_metrics.normalized_regret: regret_USD / initial_cash_risk_at_SL, the denominator = units x |entry price - SL| frozen at entry (> 0; a zero or invalid risk is a contract error); sigma-unit regret stays as the secondary form
D5_metrics.V_star: V*(t) = max(executable discretionary closes before the first automatic termination, N_auto(tau) of that termination) -- the exit spec's P* / A(t) already include the natural exit
D5_metrics.tie_policy: declared deviation from the README example ('earliest executable optimum'): a close is optimal when A(t) >= -EPS_CLOSE (0.02 sigma of the trade); the same EPS everywhere (E3 / E4 / O* / W4_v3)

D6_reversal.declared_variant: allow_reverse = 1 is the engine's close-and-reverse rule (A4-1: one close plus one entry on the same tick, both costed); it is a DECLARED VARIANT, not the README's initial single-position design
D6_reversal.reported_next_to_it: the no-reversal variant (allow_reverse = 0, the v10 canonical) in D3
